messages:
marco: Heads-up: PR #4399 updated the "structured-output" page with a new 'envelope examples' section. Two quick problems I spotted in review: the example envelope uses `params` (should be `inputs`) and the Node snippet still shows `function_call` wording in a comment.

anya: thanks — I ran the examples locally. Also the JSON schema link in the guide points to /docs/schemas/envelope.json (unversioned). We standardize on versioned names e.g. /docs/schemas/envelope-v1.json.

beth: small proposal: fix the envelope example, change comments from "function calling" -> "tool calling", and add a defensive parse example for JS. Something like:

`// sample envelope`
`{ "type": "tool_call", "tool": "wiki_search", "inputs": { "query": "redwood inference latency" } }`

`// defensive parse`
`const env = JSON.parse(body || '{}');`
`const q = env?.inputs?.query ?? null;`
`if (!q) return errorResponse('missing query');`

marco: +1. Also update the Node SDK snippet to `await model.invoke('wiki_search', { inputs: { query } })` and remove old comment about `function_call`. We prefer `invoke` for tool routing.

anya: I'll push a tiny commit: swap params->inputs, update schema link to v1, switch generate->invoke, and add the defensive parse. Can we also add a one-line test to docs CI that fetches the schema URL (HTTP 200) to avoid regressions?

beth: docs-ci already has a link-checker but it's useful to assert schema loads and validate example JSON against it with ajv. Keep it lightweight: one test file that imports the example and runs validate(example, schema).

docs-ci: noted. I'll add `test/structured/envelope.test.js` with ajv validate. Will only run in docs CI.

marco: tiny wording nit: under "Guardrails" please add: "Prefer explicit `tool` enum values in multi-tool integrations to avoid ambiguous routing." Short sentence.

anya: pushed changes to branch: envelope->inputs, schema link -> envelope-v1.json, Node snippet -> invoke(), defensive parse added, guardrail sentence added, test added to docs CI. PTAL.

beth: looked over changes; lgtm. CI hook caught one lint line-length which I fixed in a follow-up commit.

docs-ci: docs/link-checker 1 running...

docs-ci: docs/link-checker 1 success. docs/tests 1 ajv validate passed.

merge-bot: merge/ready.

marco: thanks team. After merge, let's schedule a short note in the SDK migration doc about the `params`->`inputs` rename so search works for customers. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR for that.

anya: will do. Merging now.

beth: merged 270. Closing thread.
